note: Framework-neutral control contract. Every ui-library package implements these names, props and canonical events. Generators read this file as data: `winformsTypes` picks the component, `props[].from` maps WinForms properties, `events[].from` maps WinForms events, `childOf`/`slot` place designer children. Additive changes only; a breaking change needs a major bump and a note in docs/.

transforms.mnemonic: Text 'E&xit' -> text 'Exit' + accessKey 'x' (the library renders the underline)

controls.name: WfForm
controls.a11y: Renders a landscape region labelled by title; Enter/Escape click the accept/cancel button by id.

controls.name: WfMenuBar
controls.a11y: role=menubar; children are WfMenuItem / WfSeparator; arrow-free hover/click model in 0.1.

controls.name: WfMenuItem
controls.a11y: role=menuitem; aria-haspopup/expanded when it has children; accessKey from the & mnemonic.

controls.name: WfSeparator
controls.a11y: role=separator.

controls.name: WfToolbar
controls.a11y: role=toolbar.

controls.name: WfToolbarButton

props.name: icon
props.note: Designer images live in .resx; the generator does not extract them in 0.1.

controls.a11y: button with aria-label = tooltip or text.

controls.name: WfStatusBar
controls.a11y: role=status.

controls.name: WfPanel
controls.a11y: Plain region; hidden panels are not rendered.

controls.name: WfGroupBox
controls.a11y: fieldset with a legend; disabled disables all descendants.

controls.name: WfSplit
controls.a11y: role=group; two WfSplitPane children.

controls.name: WfSplitPane
controls.a11y: Pane of a WfSplit; generated from the ParentSlot Panel1/Panel2 grouping.

controls.name: WfLabel
controls.a11y: span; use htmlFor to bind to an input.

controls.name: WfButton
controls.a11y: button; accessKey from the & mnemonic.

controls.name: WfTextBox
controls.a11y: input/textarea; label via aria-label or htmlFor.

controls.name: WfComboBox

props.name: items
props.note: JSON string array in the IR attribute `Items`.

controls.a11y: native select.

controls.name: WfCheckBox
controls.a11y: native checkbox with label.

controls.name: WfProgress
controls.a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/max.

controls.name: WfPictureBox
controls.a11y: img; provide alt.

controls.name: WfDataGrid

props.name: columns
props.note: Built from child column nodes: HeaderText -> header, DataPropertyName -> field, Width -> width, DefaultCellStyle.Format -> format.

controls.a11y: table with row selection via click and aria-selected.

controls.name: WfListView

props.name: columns
props.note: Built from child ColumnHeader nodes (Text -> header, Width -> width); kept in the page model so code can Columns.Add/Clear.

props.name: items
props.note: Page model: vm.<id>.items. Each item: text, subItems[], checked, selected, tag. SelectedItems is a filter over `selected`.

props.name: multiSelect
props.note: Defaults to true (WinForms default); the generator passes false only when the designer sets MultiSelect=false.

controls.a11y: role=grid, aria-multiselectable; rows aria-selected; arrow keys move the selection, Enter activates, Ctrl+A selects all, Ctrl/Shift click extends it.
controls.example: <WfListView columns={cols} items={vm.lv.items} onSelectionChange={sel => { vm.lv.items.forEach((it, i) => { it.selected = sel.includes(i); }); }} />

controls.name: WfContextMenu
controls.a11y: Wraps its target; right-click opens a menu of WfMenuItem children.

controls.name: WfDialog
controls.a11y: Provided as a service: alert(message), confirm(message) -> Promise<boolean>, show(render) -> Promise<result>. Replaces MessageBox and ShowDialog (DialogResult).

controls.name: useWfModel
controls.a11y: State helper, not a visual control. useWfModel(initial) returns a deep proxy: reads are immediate, writes re-render once (microtask-batched). Generated pages keep control properties (text, enabled, visible, checked, value, rows/items) and form fields in models so translated WinForms code maps 1:1.
controls.example: const vm = useWfModel({ txtSearch: { text: '', enabled: true } }); vm.txtSearch.text = 'abc';

controls.name: WfUnsupported
controls.a11y: Visible warning box; emitted for any control without a library component.
